title.zh: 复盘：看见的细节和解释分开

paragraphs.zh: 沿用虚构信封里的画、标签和玩具标记，先写能直接描述的位置，再列两个可能解释。若组织者说只是摆错，可更新记录，不必坚持一定有隐藏含义。可以只画三件道具。复盘关注描述是否清楚、解释是否可改，不以发现多少细节评法医天分，也不把这套做法用来监视、怀疑或收集真人隐私。
paragraphs.en: For the invented envelope’s drawing, label and toy token, describe their positions before offering two interpretations. Update the account if the organiser explains an accidental placement without insisting on hidden meaning. Sketch three props only if preferred. Review clear description and revisable interpretation without grading forensic talent or using the exercise to monitor, suspect or collect private information about real people.

title.zh: 借完全虚构的纸上谜题聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an entirely fictional paper puzzle

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果虚构信封里有画、标签和玩具标记，你会怎样把看见的位置与可能解释分成两栏？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a fictional envelope with a drawing, label and toy token, how would you separate visible positions from possible interpretations?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：一个问题是否对准实际空缺
title.en: Review a question against the actual information gap

paragraphs.zh: 沿用卡住的线索游戏，先写“下一步要选路线，还是要解释图案？”之类具体问题，再留回答时间。若答案仍不清，可以复述理解或暂停，不必连续追问让人表态。只改虚构说明也行。复盘看缺的信息是否被点明，不以语气强硬、回答快慢或是否说服人评诚实与沟通能力。
paragraphs.en: For the stalled clue game, ask something specific such as whether the next step chooses a route or explains a pattern, then allow time. Restate your understanding or pause if the answer remains unclear without pressing for a declaration. Revise fictional instructions only if preferred. Review the named gap without grading honesty or communication through firmness, speed or persuasion.

title.zh: 借完全虚构的纸上谜题聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an entirely fictional paper puzzle

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果大家一直聊谜题答案却没说清下一步，你会先问哪一个具体问题，再怎样确认自己听懂了？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If everyone discussed puzzle answers without a clear next step, which specific question would you ask and how would you check your understanding?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：回顾之后仍能只看或退出
title.en: Review options to watch or leave after a recap

paragraphs.zh: 沿用第一条线索拆开后才到的人，起草两句回顾，再各留一个加入、旁观和离开的入口。不要求热情回应，也不必把全部活动重开；你能说明的范围可有限。可以只写欢迎卡。复盘看信息是否够用、选择是否容易，不把参与人数或感谢当共情分数，也不用负责维持整个群体。
paragraphs.en: For someone arriving after the first clue, draft a two-sentence recap and options to join, watch or leave. Require no enthusiasm or full restart, and limit the information you can offer. Write a welcome card only if preferred. Review usable information and choices rather than participation or thanks as empathy scores, without responsibility for holding the entire group together.

title.zh: 借完全虚构的纸上谜题聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an entirely fictional paper puzzle

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友在拆完第一条线索后才来，你会怎样用两句回顾帮助其选择加入、旁观或离开？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend arrived after the first clue, how would a two-sentence recap help them choose to join, watch or leave?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：有趣的额外部分不必成为必需
title.en: Review an entertaining extra without making it compulsory

paragraphs.zh: 沿用不影响答案的玩具锁功能，分别标“可选试玩”和“本轮解题所需”，再约一个愿意者可试的小范围。不想看的人可继续原任务，不必当观众。可以只构思纸机关。复盘看趣味是否受欢迎、是否占了未约定的时间，不以笑声证明幽默或技术能力，也不拿别人取乐。
paragraphs.en: For the toy lock feature unrelated to the answer, label optional play separately from what the round requires, then offer a bounded trial to willing people. Others may continue without becoming an audience. Imagine a paper mechanism only. Review welcomed play and agreed time rather than laughter as humour or technical ability, without making someone else the joke.

title.zh: 借完全虚构的纸上谜题聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an entirely fictional paper puzzle

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果玩具锁多了一个不影响解答的小机关，你会怎样安排可选试玩，又不耽误想继续的人？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a toy lock had a feature unrelated to the solution, how would you offer optional play without delaying people who wanted to continue?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：矛盾明确，也容许解释改变看法
title.en: Review a contradiction with room to change your reading

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两张对不上的虚构卡，逐字写出冲突处，再分别考虑规则改动、编辑失误或自己误读。问什么信息能区分这几种，不把指出矛盾变成指责组织者。可以只比较自编卡片。复盘看解释是否回应原问题、有了可行答案后能否收尾；不从游戏推断谁诚实、谁易受骗或谁推理更强。
paragraphs.en: For two inconsistent fictional cards, quote the conflicting parts within your own invented material and consider a rule change, editing mistake or misreading. Ask what would distinguish these without blaming the organiser. Compare self-made cards only. Review an answer to the original gap and a stopping point, without inferring honesty, gullibility or superior reasoning from the game.

title.zh: 借完全虚构的纸上谜题聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an entirely fictional paper puzzle

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果两张虚构线索卡对不上，你会指出哪一处，再用什么信息区分规则改动、笔误或误读？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。

title.zh: 复盘：范围、认领和停止点都可修改
title.en: Review a revisable scope, ownership and stopping point

paragraphs.zh: 沿用准备点子过多的社团下午，写一个必需成果、愿意认领的人及停止点，再把额外点子列为可选。情况变化时回到约定，不把沉默当认领。可以只改虚构分工表。复盘看每人是否能更正与拒绝、缩小后是否仍好玩，不以完成多少评成熟或管理才能，也不据结果任命负责人。
paragraphs.en: For the club afternoon with too many ideas, name one essential outcome, willing owners and a stopping point, marking extras as optional. Revisit changed conditions without taking silence as ownership. Revise a fictional roster only. Review correction, refusal and enjoyment at a smaller scope without grading maturity or management talent through output or appointing a leader from a result.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果社团准备点子多于时间，你会保留哪个必需成果，再怎样约清认领、停止和缩小范围的办法？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If club preparation ideas exceeded available time, which essential outcome would you keep and how would you agree ownership, stopping and reducing scope?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.
